name: Kirishima Saeri
source:
A Japanese language teacher, the homeroom teacher of the class 2-A, the dormitory manager of the Tsugumi dorm and the adviser of the student council. She is called Sae-chan by her students. She has a sense of rivalry for Naoko because she is more reliable than her. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kono_Aozora_ni_Yakusoku_wo#Character]Wikipedia[/url]]
